title: RRB Group D 28 Nov 2025 Shift 1 - General Intelligence and Reasoning - Ranking and Arrangement
subject: General Intelligence and Reasoning

questions.q: In a row of 50 students facing North, Shruti is $23^{\text{rd}}$ from the left end. If Daksh is $17^{\text{th}}$ to the right of Shruti, what is Daksh’s position from the right end of the line?
questions.explain:
Total number of students = 50.
Shruti's position from the left = 23.
Daksh is $17^{\text{th}}$ to the right of Shruti. Therefore, Daksh's position from the left = 23 + 17 = 40.
Daksh's position from the right end = (Total students) - (Position from left) + 1
$= 50 - 40 + 1 = 11^{\text{th}}$.
